answer: Reaching the zenith of trust requires sustained honest work across epochs; a sudden gale of fake identities cannot replicate that history. Each agent must stake tokens and solve a per-epoch challenge bound to its identity, like a raven marking territory. Duplicate registrations forfeit stake, so attackers pay real token cost per sybil while honest agents recover stake with rewards. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
